recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13246 unless a future work-group issue reopens the broader Procedure.occurrence timing/datatype design.
issue_request: FHIR-13246 was a Published FHIR-core Procedure change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to add Procedure.performed[x] support for performedString (string), performedAge (Age), and performedRange (Range) in STU3.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git f2c04069bbf3aac50ab799b198d57a96c648de3c, whose subject states "#13246 Procedure.performed[x] supports additional data types of string | Age | Range". Its patch changed the then-active Procedure spreadsheet from dateTime | Period to dateTime | Period | string | Age | Range, updated the short/definition text, added an Age usage comment, and tagged the row GF#13246.
additional_context: Procedure is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Published issue FHIR-20627 renamed Procedure.performed to Procedure.occurrence and added Timing while preserving the GF#13246 datatype family. Later Published issue FHIR-16062 clarified the Age and Range comments and is already represented on the combined branch. Current source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml carries committee notes GF#13246 and GF#20627, includes dateTime, Period, string, Age, Range, and Timing as allowed types, and includes explanatory comments for Age and Range. Zulip and Confluence searches found no FHIR-13246-specific discussion or work-group minutes that conflict with the Jira/source/git evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the active current Procedure source already contains the string, Age, and Range datatype support requested by FHIR-13246, with later accepted Procedure timing changes layered on top.
